services.name: Santa Cruz Harbor Private Charters
services.desc: Experience the thrill of fishing in one of California’s most productive waters with our Santa Cruz Harbor Private Charters. These trips are perfect for beginners and families with children, offering a comfortable introduction to saltwater fishing while maintaining the excitement that keeps seasoned anglers coming back. Your adventure will target some of the area’s most abundant and delicious fish species. Rockfish and Lingcod are available April 1st through December 31st, while Halibut fishing is open year-round but best from May through October. quotes.text: We put together a family fishing trip, and we had a few first timers with us. The weather and sea state was great for fishing. Captain Tuk did an awesome job with teaching a few techniques on how to catch fish. Our first timers were the first and last to catch fish at every fishing spot, we had an amazing time. We are making plans for a different trip.
